annotations.title: Connect this chat to my letters

description: Use when the person wants to see, track or follow up on letters they sent with Piloxa in ANOTHER conversation, or wants their saved return address used. Returns a link and a 4-character code. Give the person both: they open the link, sign in with their email on piloxa.com, check the code matches, and press Allow. Only then can list_my_letters, get_my_letter and create_followup_draft see their letters, and only in this chat. It reads nothing, mails nothing and charges nothing. The person can disconnect at any time on that page.
name: connect_my_letters
title: Connect this chat to the person’s Piloxa letters
